teaser: The code a reader runs on newsroom.sgit.ai now lives on a host of its own: 74 files, hashed, versioned, never edited after publishing, proved byte for byte, pinned by the sites that use it.
core_idea: Moving the reader code of newsroom.sgit.ai to api.newsroom.sgit.ai at identical paths under a versioned prefix turns it into a client-side API with releases a site pins: the move is a prefix rewrite whose proof is a hash, the reader's data stays on the page's origin, and every change from now on is a new release with a test, a manifest and a live check, as the first fix showed on the second day.

nodes.label: A client-side API
nodes.summary: Components, formats and contracts the browser runs: 74 files, 1.15 MB, no server, a manifest of SHA-256 hashes.

nodes.label: Go slow to go fast
nodes.summary: The owner's brief: map, move without changing a byte, refactor with every test passing, review adversarially.

nodes.label: Identical paths, versioned prefix
nodes.summary: A file keeps its path under /<release>/, so moving a page is a prefix rewrite and checking it is a comparison of hashes.

nodes.label: A site pins a release
nodes.summary: The newsroom names one release in api.json, copies its manifest, and its gate fails on a reference that is unpinned, unlisted or relative.

nodes.label: Data stays on the page's origin
nodes.summary: Code loaded from another host runs on the page's origin, so the reader's balance, personas and keys stay in the newsroom's storage.

nodes.label: Three files the host forced
nodes.summary: vault-pane.js, search.js and ask.js found the site root from their own address; they now read the page's data-root, each change recorded.

nodes.label: The proof by hash
nodes.summary: 71 of 74 files identical, 24 of 24 frozen copies, 735 of 738 pages the same once normalised; the rest are the release's own pages.

nodes.label: The second cut
nodes.summary: The newsroom moved forty releases while the first cut waited, so the move was cut again from v0.12.50 as v0.2.0.

nodes.label: A change is a new release
nodes.summary: Test, version, cut, recompute every hash, three engines, deploy, tag, and ask the live host for every hash.

nodes.label: The first fix: v0.2.5
nodes.summary: A URL in the wire's lead story made the page 596 pixels wide on a 390 pixel phone; one declaration, a new release, its reason in the manifest.

nodes.label: A website with the newsroom's features
nodes.summary: Thirty pages for publishers, developers, evaluators and agents, five themes, search on the API's own component, a feed and a versions page.

nodes.label: 764 checks in fifteen tests
nodes.summary: The reader's tests run against the newsroom's real pages with the host routed to this tree, in three engines on every commit.

nodes.label: The switch, in phases
nodes.summary: newsroom.sgit.ai still serves its own copy; the next cut folds in its new work, then the pages switch a group at a time.

quotes.text: The rule of the move was identical paths under a versioned prefix.
quotes.why: The one decision that made the move checkable: a prefix rewrite whose proof is a hash.

quotes.text: That is the whole point of the move, working on its second day.
quotes.why: The first fix under the rule: a failing test, one declaration, a new release with its reason on record.
